title: ¿Cómo llegar a Valdivia? — official transport page
publisher: UTMB World Series / Torrencial Chile by UTMB
claims: Direct flights from Santiago's Arturo Merino Benítez airport (SCL) to Valdivia's Pichoy airport (ZAL) take about 1 to 1.5 hours, with LATAM, Sky Airline and JetSMART named as the main airlines.
Pichoy airport is about 30 minutes by car from central Valdivia.
Driving from Santiago to Valdivia takes about 9 to 10 hours on Ruta 5 Sur.
Bus travel from Santiago to Valdivia takes about 10 to 12 hours, with Tur-Bus and ETM named, arriving at the Terminal de Buses de Valdivia.
The page covers Santiago, Pichoy airport and the Valdivia bus terminal, and gives no Punucapa start-area transfer information.
